review.rationale: Q4 FY2025 vs Q4 FY2024 (same fiscal quarter, YoY): revenue fell from 12,606 to 11,097 USD million (−1,509 USD million, −12.0%); GAAP gross margin fell from 44.7% to 40.3% (−4.4 pp); Nike Brand digital YoY fell from −10% to −26% (16 pp further deterioration). All three required metrics deteriorated materially in the same quarter, satisfying the thesis invalidation condition 'material same-quarter sales, margin, and digital-channel deterioration'. The recovery hypothesis is contradicted by the source facts.

- Digital YoY: −26%
